
{{alias}}( document, tokens )
    Immutably unsets a value at a path in a document using structural sharing.

    Only objects and arrays along the path are shallow-cloned. All other
    subtrees keep their original references.

    Parameters
    ----------
    document: Object|Array
        Source document.

    tokens: Array<string>
        Array of reference tokens.

    Returns
    -------
    out: Object|Array
        New document with the value at the specified path removed.

    Examples
    --------
    > var doc = { 'a': { 'b': 1, 'c': 2 } };
    > var out = {{alias}}( doc, [ 'a', 'b' ] )
    { 'a': { 'c': 2 } }
    > var bool = ( doc === out )
    false

    See Also
    --------
